company_name.explanation: Enter the full legal name of the company as registered with government authorities.

industry.explanation: Select the primary industry sector that best describes your company's core business activities.

company_size.explanation: Total number of full-time equivalent employees across all locations. This helps contextualize operational complexity.

founded_year.explanation: The year the company was legally established. Indicates organizational maturity and legacy considerations.

location.explanation: Primary headquarters location. Important for regulatory, talent, and market access context.

website.explanation: Public-facing website URL. Used to understand digital presence and branding.

annual_revenue.explanation: Approximate annual revenue in Thai Baht (บาท). Helps assess scale, investment capacity, and benchmark against peers.

ownership_type.explanation: Ownership structure affects governance, decision-making speed, capital access, and strategic horizons.

contact_person.explanation: Name of the main point of contact for this assessment. Should be a senior leader with cross-functional visibility.

contact_email.explanation: Business email for the primary contact. Used for assessment communications and report delivery.

contact_phone.explanation: Direct phone number for the primary contact (include country code).

strengths_core_competencies.explanation: Select all areas where your organization has distinctive, hard-to-replicate capabilities that create competitive advantage.

strengths_brand_reputation.explanation: Rate overall brand perception among customers, partners, and industry. Consider brand awareness, trust, premium pricing ability, and employer brand.

strengths_financial_resources.text: Financial Resources and Access to Capital
strengths_financial_resources.explanation: Assess cash reserves, credit lines, investor relationships, and ability to fund growth initiatives, acquisitions, or weather downturns.

strengths_talent.text: Quality and Retention of Key Talent
strengths_talent.explanation: Evaluate ability to attract, develop, and retain top performers. Consider turnover rates, employer brand, leadership pipeline, and critical role coverage.

strengths_technology_ip.explanation: Select all technology and intellectual property assets that create barriers to entry for competitors.

strengths_operational_efficiency.explanation: Compare your cost structure, cycle times, asset utilization, and productivity metrics against industry benchmarks and key competitors.

strengths_customer_loyalty.explanation: Measure customer retention, repeat purchase rate, net revenue retention, and switching costs. High loyalty reduces CAC and stabilizes revenue.

strengths_supply_chain.text: Supply Chain Reliability and Partner Relationships
strengths_supply_chain.explanation: Assess supplier diversification, strategic partnerships, visibility, risk management, and ability to maintain continuity during disruptions.

strengths_other.explanation: Select any additional strengths not covered above.

weaknesses_skill_gaps.explanation: Select all missing capabilities needed for current and future strategy.

weaknesses_legacy_systems.explanation: Outdated software/systems that are difficult to update, slow to fix bugs, costly to maintain, and limit your ability to add new features or adopt new technology.

weaknesses_financial_constraints.text: Financial Constraints or High Debt Levels
weaknesses_financial_constraints.explanation: Assess debt-to-equity, interest coverage, covenant restrictions, and limited free cash flow that constrain strategic investments.

weaknesses_process_inefficiencies.explanation: Select all process issues that reduce speed and increase cost.

weaknesses_market_presence.explanation: Select all areas where competitors have stronger foothold or you lack presence.

weaknesses_innovation_pipeline.explanation: Evaluate the quantity, quality, and strategic alignment of projects in your innovation funnel from ideation to commercialization.

weaknesses_org_structure.explanation: Assess cross-functional collaboration, decision-making speed, accountability clarity, and adaptability to change.

weaknesses_data_analytics.text: Data Analytics and BI Capability Level
weaknesses_data_analytics.explanation: How well does your organization use data? Assess: data infrastructure (warehouses, lakes), analytics tools (Excel, BI, AI), self-service reporting (can staff get reports without IT?), predictive modeling (forecasting), and data-driven culture (decisions based on data, not gut feel).

weaknesses_other.explanation: Select additional weaknesses not covered above.

opportunities_market_growth.explanation: Select all market growth trends aligned with your capabilities that you can capitalize on.

opportunities_new_markets.explanation: Select all new markets or segments you could target with existing or adapted offerings.

opportunities_technology.explanation: Select specific technologies that could transform your products, operations, or business model.

opportunities_partnerships.explanation: Select all partnership types that could accelerate your strategy.

opportunities_regulatory.explanation: Select regulatory shifts that create new markets or favor your capabilities.

opportunities_sustainability.explanation: Select all sustainability-driven opportunities relevant to your business.

opportunities_digital_transformation.explanation: Select all digital opportunities to create new value or improve operations.

opportunities_other.explanation: Select any other opportunities not covered above.

threats_competition.explanation: Select all competitive threats facing your business.

threats_economic.explanation: Select all macroeconomic threats affecting demand or margins.

threats_regulatory.explanation: Select all regulatory threats that increase costs or restrict operations.

threats_supply_chain.explanation: Assess single-source dependencies, geographic concentration, geopolitical risks, and logistics vulnerabilities.

threats_technology_disruption.text: Technology Disruption Risk to Business Model
threats_technology_disruption.explanation: Evaluate risk of obsolescence from AI, automation, new materials, business model innovation, or shifting customer expectations.

threats_talent_shortage.explanation: Assess difficulty hiring/retaining specialized talent (engineers, data scientists, skilled trades) and impact on execution.

threats_cybersecurity.text: Cybersecurity and Data Privacy Risk Level
threats_cybersecurity.explanation: Evaluate maturity of security posture, incident response, data protection compliance, and supply chain cyber risk.

threats_other.explanation: Select additional threats not covered above.

swot_priority_actions.explanation: Select the top 3-5 focus areas for priority actions from your SWOT analysis.

swot_strategic_fit.explanation: Rate alignment between your current strategic plan and SWOT findings. Low scores indicate strategy needs recalibration.

vision_statement.explanation: Assess if vision describes desired future state (3-10 years), is aspirational, clear, and guides long-term decisions.

mission_statement.explanation: Assess if mission defines core purpose: what you do, for whom, and how you create value. Should be actionable and differentiating.

core_values.explanation: Assess if 3-5 values drive behavior and decision-making, with definitions, and are lived not just posted.

strategic_horizon.explanation: Primary timeframe for strategic plan. Longer horizons (3-5+ years) indicate mature strategic thinking; shorter may indicate reactivity.

strategic_priorities.explanation: Assess if top 3-5 priorities are specific (e.g., 'Expand APAC revenue to $50M'), measurable, with owners and timelines.

kpis_defined.explanation: Assess if each priority has leading/lagging KPIs with targets, and if they cascade to team/individual levels for accountability.

strategy_review_frequency.explanation: Frequency of formal strategy reviews with leadership. Quarterly is best practice for agility; annual-only suggests rigidity.

okr_adoption.explanation: OKRs align teams to strategy through measurable outcomes. Full implementation means company-wide, quarterly cycles with transparent tracking.

resource_allocation.explanation: Formal portfolio process = stage-gated funding with ROI hurdles. Annual budgeting = incremental. Ad-hoc = reactive, often misaligned.

scenario_planning.explanation: Regular scenario planning (3-4 scenarios) builds resilience. Assesses impact of economic, technological, regulatory, or competitive shifts on strategy.

competitive_positioning.explanation: Per Porter's generic strategies. 'Stuck in Middle' = no clear advantage. Transitioning = deliberately shifting position.

strategy_execution_score.explanation: Honest assessment: % of strategic initiatives completed on time/budget, % of KPIs met, and organizational alignment. Below 6 signals execution gaps.

strategy_communication.explanation: Test: Can frontline employees articulate top 3 priorities and their role? Poor communication is a top cause of execution failure.

change_management.explanation: Assess structured approach: sponsorship, communication, training, resistance management, and reinforcement for strategic changes.

strategic_risks.explanation: Assess if top 3 strategic risks (market, technology, execution, financial) have likelihood, impact, owner, and specific mitigation actions.

production_type.explanation: MTS = forecast-driven inventory. MTO = build after order. ETO = custom engineering per order. ATO = configure standard modules. Process = continuous/batch (chemicals, food). Job Shop = high mix, low volume.

num_facilities.explanation: Total manufacturing sites globally. Impacts complexity, coordination, standardization, and supply chain footprint.

total_capacity_utilization.explanation: Actual output / theoretical maximum capacity. 85-95% is typical target; >95% risks bottlenecks, <70% indicates underutilized assets.

production_scheduling.explanation: APS = optimization algorithms for complex constraints. ERP/MRP = standard. Kanban = pull-based. Manual = error-prone. TOC = bottleneck-focused.

lean_maturity.explanation: World Class = lean culture, continuous flow, pull systems, standard work everywhere. Basic = 5S and some Kaizen. Assess honestly.

lean_tools_used.explanation: Select all actively used (not just tried once). SMED = quick changeover. TPM = autonomous maintenance. Hoshin = strategy deployment.

quality_system.explanation: Formal certification indicates disciplined processes. IATF 16949 = automotive. ISO 13485 = medical. AS9100 = aerospace. Six Sigma = statistical process control.

defect_rate.explanation: Parts per Million (PPM) or percentage of units failing quality standards. World-class < 100 PPM. Track internal + customer-reported.

first_pass_yield.explanation: % of units passing all quality checks without rework on first attempt. FPY > 95% is strong; < 90% indicates process instability.

scrap_rework_cost.explanation: Total cost of scrap, rework, warranty, returns / revenue. Best-in-class < 1%. > 5% signals systemic quality issues.

inventory_turns.explanation: COGS / Average Inventory. Higher = better cash flow, less obsolescence. Industry-specific: 12+ for electronics, 4-6 for heavy machinery.

wip_levels.explanation: WIP ties up cash, increases lead time, hides quality issues. Optimized = minimal WIP per Little's Law (WIP = Throughput × Cycle Time).

maintenance_strategy.explanation: PdM = IoT sensors + AI prediction. PM = time-based. CBM = vibration/oil analysis. Reactive = highest cost/downtime. TPM = operator involvement.

equipment_availability.explanation: Actual running time / scheduled time. World-class > 90%. Includes planned + unplanned downtime. Key OEE component.

changeover_time.explanation: Time from last good part of previous run to first good part of next run. SMED target: < 10 min (single-digit minutes).

production_lead_time.explanation: Order release to shipment. Includes wait, move, queue, setup, run times. Shorter = more responsive, less WIP, better quality.

on_time_delivery.explanation: % of orders delivered by promised date. > 95% is competitive. Track by customer, product line, and root cause of misses.

production_kpis.explanation: Select KPIs reviewed at least weekly with visual management. OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality (gold standard).

digital_manufacturing.explanation: Advanced = digital twins, AI optimization, autonomous systems. Connected = real-time data from machines. Automated = MES/SCADA. Basic = ERP only.

bottlenecks.explanation: Select all constraint types currently limiting throughput.

sales_model.explanation: Primary go-to-market motion. Hybrid = multiple models. Subscription/SaaS = recurring revenue. Project-based = complex, long-cycle deals.

sales_team_size.explanation: Total quota-carrying reps (AEs, SDRs, AMs). Exclude support/ops. Ratio of reps to revenue indicates productivity.

marketing_team_size.explanation: Total marketing FTEs (demand gen, product marketing, brand, ops, content). Typical ratio: 1 marketer per 3-5 sales reps.

annual_marketing_budget.explanation: Total marketing spend / revenue. B2B typical: 5-10%. High-growth: 15-30%. Include people, programs, tech, agencies.

target_markets.explanation: Assess if target segments are defined by industry, company size, geography, buyer persona, use case, prioritized by TAM, win rate, and strategic fit.

value_proposition.explanation: Assess if value prop clearly states: target customer, problem solved, unique benefit, proof. Format: 'For [segment], [product] provides [benefit] unlike [alternative] by [differentiator].'

brand_positioning.explanation: Assess if positioning includes frame of reference, point of difference, and reason to believe vs. competitors.

lead_generation_channels.explanation: Select top 3-5 channels by volume and quality. Track cost per lead and conversion by channel for optimization.

marketing_qualified_leads.explanation: Leads meeting demographic/firmographic + engagement criteria. Definition must be agreed with sales. Track trend and quality.

sales_qualified_leads.explanation: MQLs vetted by sales (BANT/MEDDIC). SQL volume indicates marketing-sales handoff effectiveness.

mql_to_sql_conversion.explanation: SQLs / MQLs. Low rate = poor lead quality or misaligned criteria. Benchmark: 15-30% for B2B.

sql_to_opportunity.explanation: Opportunities created / SQLs. Measures sales qualification rigor. Benchmark: 40-60%.

win_rate.explanation: Closed-won / (Closed-won + Closed-lost). Exclude 'no decision.' Track by segment, rep, product. > 30% is strong for complex B2B.

average_deal_size.explanation: Mean revenue per closed deal (ARR for SaaS, total contract for projects). Track trend and distribution (median vs. mean).

sales_cycle_length.explanation: Days from SQL/opportunity creation to close. Longer cycles = higher CAC, more risk. Segment by deal size and type.

customer_acquisition_cost.explanation: Total sales + marketing spend / new customers acquired. Include all costs: people, programs, tech, overhead. Track by channel/segment.

customer_lifetime_value.explanation: Average revenue per customer × gross margin × average customer lifespan. For SaaS: ARPU × margin / churn rate.

ltv_cac_ratio.explanation: LTV / CAC. > 3x = healthy. < 3x = payback too long. > 5x = under-investing in growth. Track payback period too.

churn_rate.explanation: % of customers/revenue lost per year. Logo churn vs. revenue churn (net negative churn = expansion > contraction). SaaS target: < 5-7%.

net_revenue_retention.explanation: (Starting MRR + Expansion - Contraction - Churn) / Starting MRR. > 100% = growth from existing base. Best-in-class > 120%.

crm_system.explanation: Primary CRM. Adoption rate and data quality matter more than tool. Integrate with marketing automation and ERP.

marketing_automation.explanation: Platform for email, nurture, scoring, attribution. Enables scale. Integration with CRM is critical for closed-loop reporting.

sales_process_maturity.explanation: Optimized = continuous improvement via data. Defined & Measured = stages, gates, metrics. Ad-hoc = hero-dependent, not scalable.

pricing_strategy.explanation: Value-based = price to customer ROI (best margins). Cost-plus = commodity trap. Dynamic = demand-based. Tiered = capture segments.

competitive_intelligence.explanation: Formal = dedicated resources, tools, regular briefings. Enables proactive positioning and win/loss analysis.

customer_feedback_loop.explanation: Systematic = NPS/CSAT + root cause analysis + closed-loop follow-up + product/process improvements. Measure action rate.

nps_score.explanation: % Promoters (9-10) - % Detractors (0-6). B2B benchmark: 30-50 (good), 50+ (excellent). Track by segment and account tier.

sales_marketing_alignment.explanation: SLA = shared definitions, revenue targets, lead handoff process, joint planning. Misalignment wastes 10%+ of revenue.

top_sales_challenges.explanation: Select top 3-5 sales challenges by priority.

top_marketing_challenges.explanation: Select top 3-5 marketing challenges by priority.

rd_budget_pct.explanation: Total R&D spend (people, facilities, tools, external) / revenue. Industry benchmarks: Pharma 15-25%, Tech 10-20%, Industrial 3-8%, Consumer 2-5%.

rd_team_size.explanation: Total R&D headcount (researchers, engineers, technicians, PMs). Ratio to revenue indicates intensity. Track seniority mix (PhD, MS, BS).

rd_structure.explanation: Centralized = core labs. Decentralized = embedded in BUs. Matrix = dual reporting. Virtual = network of partners. Outsourced = contract R&D.

innovation_strategy.explanation: Comprehensive = portfolio strategy, focus areas, governance, metrics, funding model, culture initiatives. Basic = focus areas only.

innovation_horizons.explanation: H1 = core improvements, H2 = adjacent opportunities, H3 = transformational. Adjust for industry lifecycle.

new_product_development_process.explanation: Optimized = gates with kill criteria, portfolio mgmt, metrics. Standard = defined phases. Agile = sprints, MVPs. Hybrid = stage-gate + agile.

products_launched_yearly.explanation: Count of commercially launched products (not variants). Includes new platforms, line extensions, geographic expansions.

new_product_success_rate.explanation: % of launched products meeting revenue/margin targets at 12-24 months. Industry avg: 20-40%. Best-in-class > 60%.

revenue_from_new_products.explanation: Vitality index. > 30% = healthy pipeline. < 10% = innovation stagnation. Track by business unit.

patents_filed_yearly.explanation: Provisional + non-provisional applications. Quality > quantity. Track grant rate and citation impact.

patents_granted_total.explanation: Active granted patents in force. Indicates IP portfolio strength, freedom to operate, and licensing potential.

rd_collaboration.explanation: Select active partnerships (joint projects, funded research, IP licensing). Diversity of partners reduces risk and expands knowledge.

open_innovation.explanation: Extensive = systematic scouting, corporate VC, innovation challenges, co-creation. None = strictly internal R&D.

technology_scanning.explanation: Systematic = dedicated team, tools (patent analytics, startup databases), regular reports to leadership. Ad-hoc = reactive to threats.

innovation_culture_score.explanation: Assess: psychological safety, tolerance for failure, time for exploration, cross-functional collaboration, leadership role-modeling, reward systems.

idea_management.explanation: Active platform = high submission rate, transparent evaluation, fast implementation, recognition. Low usage = platform exists but ignored.

r_digital_tools.explanation: PLM = product lifecycle management. CAE = computer-aided engineering. ELN = digital lab records. AI/ML for materials discovery, simulation.

time_to_market.explanation: Concept to first revenue. Shorter = competitive advantage, higher NPV. Segment by complexity (platform vs. derivative).

rd_productivity_metrics.explanation: Track input (spend), process (utilization, cycle time), output (patents, launches), outcome (revenue, margin) metrics.

technical_debt.explanation: Legacy architectures, outdated tech stacks, deferred refactoring, missing documentation. Critical = blocks new features, security risk.

sustainability_innovation.explanation: Core = sustainability is primary innovation driver (circular, bio-based, energy transition). Exploring = pilots only.

top_innovation_challenges.explanation: Select top 3-5 innovation challenges by priority.

labor_productivity_trend.explanation: Output per labor hour trend. >5%/yr = strong (automation, lean, tech). Flat/declining = investigate causes (mix, utilization, skill gaps).

revenue_per_employee.explanation: Revenue / total FTEs. Benchmarks: SaaS $300-500K, Manufacturing $200-400K, Services $150-300K. Track trend, not just absolute.

value_added_per_employee.explanation: (Revenue - Material/Service Costs) / FTEs. Better than revenue/FTE as it removes pass-through costs. Measures true economic contribution.

overtime_percentage.explanation: Overtime hours / total hours. > 5-10% indicates capacity constraint, poor planning, or staffing gaps. Chronic OT = burnout, quality, safety risks.

absenteeism_rate.explanation: Unscheduled absence hours / scheduled hours. > 3-4% is high. Track by department, shift, season. Root cause: health, engagement, management.

employee_utilization.explanation: Direct = value-adding (production, service delivery). Indirect = support (maintenance, quality, supervision, admin). Target: maximize direct %.

automation_level.explanation: Lights-out = no human intervention. Highly = robots/CNC with operators. Partial = key steps automated. Assess by process, not whole factory.

process_standardization.explanation: Standard work documented, visual, trained, audited. Enables quality, productivity, training, and continuous improvement baseline.

continuous_improvement.explanation: Embedded = every employee improves daily (Kaizen). Active = structured program, dedicated resources. Pilot = limited scope. Ad-hoc = reactive.

improvement_ideas_per_employee.explanation: Total ideas / total employees. World-class: >10-20/employee/year (Toyota ~30). Low = culture or process barrier.

improvement_implementation_rate.explanation: Implemented / submitted. High rate = effective evaluation, fast approval, recognition. Low rate = bottleneck, poor ideas, or lack of resources.

productivity_measurement.explanation: Engineered standards = predetermined times (MOST, MTM). Real-time = IoT/wearables. Manual = stopwatch/spreadsheet. Not Measured = flying blind.

bottleneck_analysis.explanation: Theory of Constraints: identify constraint, exploit, subordinate, elevate, repeat. Weekly = responsive. Quarterly+ = slow improvement.

workforce_skills_matrix.explanation: Matrix mapping employees vs. required skills/certifications. Enables cross-training, succession planning, gap identification, flexible scheduling.

training_hours_per_employee.explanation: Total training hours / FTEs. Best-in-class: 40-80+ hours. Include technical, safety, lean, leadership, digital skills. Track completion rate.

cross_training_level.explanation: % of workforce certified on multiple operations. Extensive = flexible scheduling, absentee coverage, career paths, engagement.

ergonomics_safety.explanation: World Class = proactive ergonomics, zero injuries, employee-driven. Compliant = meets regulations only. Ergonomics improves productivity + retention.

environmental_certifications.explanation: ISO 14001 = EMS. EMAS = EU enhanced. ISO 50001 = energy mgmt. LEED = buildings. B Corp = holistic. SBTi = validated targets.

waste_tracking_system.explanation: Real-time = IoT sensors, auto-reporting. ERP = transactional data. Manual = monthly weighbridge tickets. None = unknown waste streams.

total_waste_generated.explanation: All waste streams: hazardous, non-hazardous, universal, construction. Track by category, process, facility. Baseline for reduction targets.

hazardous_waste_pct.explanation: Regulated waste requiring special handling/disposal. High % = regulatory risk, cost, liability. Target: reduce via substitution, process change.

waste_diversion_rate.explanation: (Recycled + Composted + Reused + Energy Recovery) / Total Waste. Zero Waste to Landfill = >90-95%. Exclude hazardous if no alt.

recycling_rate.explanation: Materials recycled / total waste generated. Track by material (metal, plastic, paper, organic). Quality of recycle stream matters (downcycling).

circular_economy_initiatives.explanation: Select active programs. Design for recycling = mono-materials, easy disassembly. Industrial symbiosis = waste = neighbor's input.

water_consumption.explanation: Total withdrawal from all sources (municipal, groundwater, surface). Track by process. Water-stressed regions need intensity metrics (m³/unit).

water_recycling_rate.explanation: Recycled/reused water / total withdrawal. Includes cooling tower blowdown recovery, RO permeate reuse, rainwater harvesting.

energy_consumption.explanation: Electricity + fuels (natural gas, diesel, steam) converted to MWh. Track by facility, process. Baseline for intensity (MWh/unit) and reduction.

renewable_energy_pct.explanation: On-site solar/wind + purchased RECs/PPAs + green tariff / total consumption. Distinguish additionality (new capacity) vs. certificates.

carbon_footprint_scope12.explanation: Scope 1 = direct combustion, process emissions, fugitive. Scope 2 = purchased electricity/heat/steam (location + market-based).

carbon_footprint_scope3.explanation: Scope 3 = value chain (purchased goods, transport, use of product, end-of-life). Often 70-90% of total. Start with top categories.

carbon_reduction_target.explanation: Absolute or intensity target. Align with SBTi (1.5°C = 4.2%/yr linear). Include Scope 3 if >40% of total. Net Zero = 90-95% reduction + removals.

lean_green_integration.explanation: Integrated = waste elimination = environmental reduction (e.g., SMED reduces energy, defects = scrap). Aligned = shared goals, separate teams.

material_efficiency.explanation: Product output weight / raw material input weight. Higher = less waste. Track by product line. Theoretical max = 1.0 (no waste).

supplier_environmental_requirements.explanation: Mandatory = ISO 14001 required for key suppliers. Scoring = ESG scorecards. Code = signed commitment. Audit high-risk suppliers.

waste_cost_savings.text: Annual Cost Savings from Waste Reduction
waste_cost_savings.explanation: Avoided disposal fees + material savings + revenue from by-products + energy savings. Quantify to build business case for sustainability.

environmental_incidents.explanation: Spills, exceedances, notices of violation, fines, community complaints. Track severity, root cause, corrective action closure.

sustainability_reporting.explanation: GRI = comprehensive. SASB = industry-specific financial materiality. TCFD = climate risk. CSRD (EU) mandates for many non-EU cos.

top_waste_challenges.explanation: Select top 3-5 waste management challenges by priority.

bioeconomy_strategy.explanation: Comprehensive = targets, investment plan, governance, partnerships. Bioeconomy = renewable biological resources for food, materials, energy.

bio_based_materials_pct.text: % of Raw Materials from Bio-based Sources
bio_based_materials_pct.explanation: Weight or cost % of inputs from biomass (agricultural, forestry, marine, waste). Excludes fossil-based. Track by material category.

bio_products_revenue.explanation: Revenue from products with >25% bio-based content (per EN 16785). Includes intermediates, chemicals, materials, consumer goods.

bio_rnd_investment.text: R&D Investment in Bio-innovation (% of R&D Budget)
bio_rnd_investment.explanation: Portion of R&D spend on bio-based materials, bioprocesses, synthetic biology, enzymatic routes, fermentation scale-up.

bio_partnerships.explanation: Select active collaborations: joint research, talent pipeline, pilot facilities, cluster memberships (e.g., Bio-based Industries Consortium).

bio_certifications.explanation: USDA BioPreferred = US federal procurement. OK biobased = EU (Vinçotte). ISCC PLUS = mass balance, circular. RSB = sustainability.

biotech_adoption.explanation: Advanced = precision fermentation, enzyme engineering, metabolic pathway design, cell-free systems. Basic = buying bio-based feedstocks only.

bio_supply_chain.explanation: Traceability to farm/plantation level. Certifications (RSPO, RTRS, FSC). Risk: land use change, biodiversity, social. Digital traceability (blockchain).

circular_strategy.explanation: Comprehensive = circular design, business models, reverse logistics, metrics, targets. Ellen MacArthur framework: eliminate, circulate, regenerate.

circular_maturity.explanation: Regenerative = net positive (C2C certified). Circular = closed loops (recycle, remanufacture, PaaS). Recycling only = downcycling risk.

recycled_content_pct.explanation: Post-consumer + post-industrial recycled content by weight. Track by product line. Targets: EU PPWR 30% plastic packaging by 2030.

product_lifecycle_extension.explanation: PaaS = retain ownership, sell performance. Remanufacturing = as-new with warranty. Modular = upgradeable, repairable. Track revenue % from circular models.

waste_to_resource.explanation: Symbiosis = waste = neighbor's input (Kalundborg model). Valorization = high-value from by-products. Chemical recycling = monomer recovery.

circular_design_principles.explanation: Embed in NPD process. DfD = fasteners not glue, material labeling. DfR = spare parts, manuals, diagnostic interfaces. Standardize = reduce SKUs.

packaging_circularity.explanation: Reusable = returnable containers. Recyclable = mono-material, no problematic additives. Compostable = certified (EN 13432). Assess full portfolio.

circular_revenue_models.text: Revenue from Circular Business Models (% of Total)
circular_revenue_models.explanation: PaaS, leasing, remanufacturing sales, take-back refurbishment, recycling services. Excludes virgin product sales. Target: grow this %.

circular_kpis.explanation: MCI (Ellen MacArthur) = 0-1 score. CTI (WBCSD) = corporate level. Resource productivity = revenue / material input.

green_strategy.text: Formal Green Economy / Net Zero Strategy
green_strategy.explanation: Net Zero (SBTi) = 90-95% reduction + permanent removals by 2050. Carbon Neutral = offsetting (transition only). Basic = incremental improvements.

scope12_emissions.explanation: Scope 1 = direct (combustion, process, fugitive). Scope 2 = indirect energy (location + market-based). Report both. Third-party verification.

scope3_emissions.explanation: 15 categories. Start with: purchased goods (Cat 1), upstream transport (4), use of sold products (11), end-of-life (12). Often 70-90% of total.

renewable_energy_pct.explanation: On-site generation + PPAs + green tariffs + RECs / total. Additionality matters: new capacity > unbundled RECs. RE100 = 100% target.

energy_efficiency_improvement.explanation: (Baseline - Current) / Baseline energy intensity (MWh/unit). Cumulative. Track by facility, process. ISO 50001 drives systematic improvement.

water_stewardship.explanation: AWS = Alliance for Water Stewardship standard (catchment context). Comprehensive = targets, risk assessment, collective action. Compliance = permit limits only.

biodiversity_action.explanation: TNFD = Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (like TCFD). No Net Loss = mitigate hierarchy. Deforestation-free = DCF, EUDR compliance.

green_finance.explanation: SLL = margin ratchet on KPIs. Green bonds = use of proceeds. Carbon credits = voluntary market (avoidance/removal). Disclose integrity (ICVCM).

carbon_pricing_internal.explanation: Shadow = decision-making ($/tCO2e in CAPEX). Internal fee = business units pay central fund for emissions. Drives low-carbon investment.

climate_transition_plan.explanation: CTP = governance, targets, actions, capital allocation, policy engagement, just transition. TCFD/GFANZ/ESRS aligned. Board-approved.

bcg_governance.explanation: Board committee = oversight. CSO = executive accountability. Steering = cross-BU alignment. Working groups = execution. External = credibility.

bcg_kpi_integration.text: BCG KPIs Integrated into Executive Compensation?
bcg_kpi_integration.explanation: Significant = >15-20% of variable pay. Moderate = 5-15%. Minor = <5%. Aligns incentives with long-term transformation.

bcg_digital_tools.explanation: LCA = life cycle assessment (cradle-to-grave). DPP = EU regulation (product data). Blockchain = supply chain transparency. AI = process optimization.

bcg_stakeholder_engagement.explanation: Map stakeholders by influence/interest. Co-create targets with suppliers. Investor dialogue on transition risk. Community = social license.

bcg_training.explanation: Comprehensive = all levels, certified, ongoing. Role-specific = procurement (sustainable sourcing), R&D (circular design), ops (energy mgmt).

bcg_regulatory_readiness.text: Readiness for Key Regulations (EU Taxonomy, CSRD, CBAM, PPWR, etc.)
bcg_regulatory_readiness.explanation: Taxonomy = eligibility/alignment reporting. CSRD = double materiality, ESRS. CBAM = carbon border tax (iron, steel, aluminum, cement, hydrogen, electricity). PPWR = packaging waste.

bcg_priorities.explanation: Select top 3-5 funded, owned, measurable BCG transformation priorities.

oee_tracked.explanation: Real-time = IIoT/MES auto-capture. Manual = operator logs per shift. Periodic = weekly/monthly studies. Not tracked = no visibility.

oee_overall.explanation: OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality. World-class = 85%+. Typical = 60-75%. Low = prioritize biggest loss component.

oee_availability.explanation: Run Time / Planned Production Time. Losses: breakdowns, changeovers, maintenance, no operator/material. Target > 90%.

oee_performance.explanation: (Ideal Cycle Time × Total Count) / Run Time. Losses: micro-stops, reduced speed. Target > 95%.

oee_quality.explanation: Good Count / Total Count. Losses: startup scrap, production scrap, rework. Target > 99.9% (Six Sigma).

oee_target.explanation: Annual improvement target. Typical: +3-5%/yr. Set by component (e.g., Availability 90% → 93%, Quality 99.5% → 99.8%).

oee_world_class.text: World-Class OEE Benchmark for Your Industry (%)
oee_world_class.explanation: Industry-specific: Discrete 85%, Process 90%, Pharma 80%, Automotive 85%. Know your benchmark to set realistic targets.

equipment_covered.text: % of Critical Equipment Covered by OEE
equipment_covered.explanation: Critical = bottleneck, high-value, quality-critical. 100% = all constraints monitored. Start with constraint (Theory of Constraints).

oee_data_collection.explanation: Automated = PLC signals (run/stop, count, reject) → MES. Semi = auto counts + manual reason codes. Manual = error-prone, delayed.

oee_frequency.explanation: Real-time = immediate response. Per shift = handoff review. Daily = management review. Monthly = too slow for improvement.

six_big_losses_tracked.explanation: 6 Losses: 1) Breakdowns, 2) Setup/Adjust, 3) Idling/Minor Stops, 4) Reduced Speed, 5) Startup Defects, 6) Production Defects. Categorize to prioritize.

availability_losses.explanation: Breakdowns = PdM target. Changeovers = SMED target. Maintenance = PM optimization. No operator = scheduling/staffing.

performance_losses.explanation: Micro-stops (<5 min) often hidden, major cumulative loss. Reduced speed = running below ideal rate. Startup = ramp losses.

quality_losses.explanation: Startup scrap = process stabilization. Production scrap = steady-state variation. Rework = hidden cost. Track by defect type (Pareto).

tpm_program.explanation: 8 Pillars: 1) Autonomous Maint, 2) Planned Maint, 3) Focused Improvement, 4) Quality Maint, 5) Early Mgmt, 6) Training, 7) Admin, 8) Safety/Env. Assess maturity.

oee_initiatives.explanation: Select active OEE improvement initiatives with expected impact.

oee_challenges.explanation: Select top challenges hindering OEE improvement.
